newsitem.title: USA: No bids on surplus U.S. beryl ore, cadmium - Agency.
newsitem.headline: No bids on surplus U.S. beryl ore, cadmium - Agency.

text.p: The U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center said Wednesday it received no bids for surplus beryl ore or cadmium at its monthly offerings.
The agency also announced it made no awards of surplus graphite from a bid opening held in late August. Bid opening for cadmium and beryl ore was Tuesday.
Next bid opening for cadmium and beryl ore was set for October 8 at 1400 EDT/1800 GMT at the agency's offices in suburban Fort Belvoir, Virginia.
Next bid opening for surplus graphite was set for September 25 at 1400/1800.
